questions.q_en: Take me through the phosphorelay itself. Where does the phosphate come from, where does it go, and what happens to it when you take the green light away?
questions.q_zh: 請帶我走一遍磷酸傳遞本身。磷酸從哪裡來、傳到哪裡去，綠光移除之後它又怎麼了？
questions.a_en: Green light is absorbed by the phycocyanobilin bound to CcaS-m3. That shifts the protein's conformation, and the kinase takes a phosphate off ATP onto a histidine on itself, because CcaS-m3 is a histidine kinase photoreceptor. The phosphoryl group then goes to an aspartate on the receiver domain of CcaR, and phosphorylated CcaR switches into its DNA-binding state and turns on PcpcG2-veg. Switching off is the same chemistry in reverse: red light near 672 nanometres drives CcaS back toward its dark state and phospho-CcaR loses its phosphate, so output decays. Neither rate has been measured on our strain; we take the published Bacillus curve as it stands.
questions.a_zh: 綠光被結合在 CcaS-m3 上的 phycocyanobilin 吸收，蛋白的構形改變，kinase 就把 ATP 上的磷酸轉到自己的一個 histidine 上，因為 CcaS-m3 是 histidine kinase 型的光受體。磷酸基接著傳到 CcaR 接收區的 aspartate，磷酸化的 CcaR 轉成能結合 DNA 的狀態，把 PcpcG2-veg 打開。關閉是同一套化學反過來跑：約 672 nm 的紅光把 CcaS 推回暗態，磷酸化的 CcaR 失去磷酸，輸出就衰減。這兩個速率我們都沒有在自己的菌株上量過，Bacillus 的曲線是直接採用文獻的。
questions.trap_en: Saying CcaS-m3 itself binds the promoter, or describing the published kinetics as if the team had measured them.
questions.trap_zh: 說 CcaS-m3 自己去結合啟動子，或把文獻的動力學講得像是團隊自己量過的。
questions.basis: tests whether the student owns the chemistry, not the cartoon

questions.q_en: Suppose the circuit works tomorrow. What physically sets the floor and the ceiling of what you can get out of PcpcG2-veg?
questions.q_zh: 假設電路明天就會動。那麼 PcpcG2-veg 的輸出下限和上限，實際上是由什麼決定的？
questions.a_en: The floor is basal transcription, and we have evidence it is not zero: on the light plate the red lane at full power was not silent at eight hours, and red is meant to be the off condition. The output promoter is a hybrid, PcpcG2 fused to veg, so some firing with no signal is expected; dark-state CcaS-m3 also phosphorylates a little, and plasmid copy number multiplies whatever one copy does, which we never measured. The ceiling is saturation. The published half-maximal intensity in Bacillus is 4.66 micromoles per square metre per second, and our lamp ceiling of twenty reaches 0.94 of maximum.
questions.a_zh: 下限是基礎轉錄，而我們有證據它不是零：在光盤上，全功率紅光那一道在八小時並不是完全沉默，而紅光本來應該是關的條件。輸出啟動子是融合的，PcpcG2 接上 veg，所以沒有訊號時也會有一些啟動；暗態的 CcaS-m3 也會有一點磷酸化，而 plasmid copy number 會把單套的輸出乘上去，這個我們沒量過。上限是飽和。文獻在 Bacillus 的半飽和光強是 4.66 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹，我們燈的上限二十就已經到最大值的 0.94。
questions.trap_en: Answering only about light intensity, and forgetting that red at full power already gave signal on their own blot.
questions.trap_zh: 只談光強度，忘了自己的墨點上全功率紅光本來就有訊號。
questions.basis: dynamic range is a design consequence they can reason about

questions.q_en: CcaS, CcaR and PcpcG2 are cyanobacterial. What did you have to change to run them in Bacillus subtilis, and what did you deliberately leave alone?
questions.q_zh: CcaS、CcaR 和 PcpcG2 都來自藍綠菌。要在 Bacillus subtilis 裡跑，你們改了什麼，又刻意不動什麼？
questions.a_en: Three things changed. The chromophore: Bacillus makes no phycocyanobilin, so the device carries ho1 and pcyA, where Ho1 oxidises the cell's own heme to biliverdin IX-alpha and PcyA reduces that to PCB. The receptor: Castillo-Hair induced the sensor with xylose or IPTG, and we put it behind constitutive Bacillus promoters, PlepA or PliaG, so CcaS-m3 is present all the time and we cannot tune its level the way that paper could. The output promoter is a hybrid, PcpcG2 fused to veg, not the native cyanobacterial promoter. What we left alone is the proteins; CcaS-m3 and CcaR are the published sequences.
questions.a_zh: 改了三件事。發色團：Bacillus 不會做 phycocyanobilin，所以裝置要帶 ho1 和 pcyA，Ho1 把細胞自己的 heme 氧化成 biliverdin IXα，PcyA 再還原成 PCB。受體：Castillo-Hair 是用木糖或 IPTG 誘導 sensor，我們把它放在 Bacillus 的持續型啟動子後面，PlepA 或 PliaG，所以 CcaS-m3 一直都在，我們沒辦法像那篇一樣調整它的量。輸出啟動子是融合的，PcpcG2 接上 veg，不是原本藍綠菌的啟動子。沒動的是蛋白本身，CcaS-m3 和 CcaR 用的都是文獻序列。
questions.trap_en: Claiming they redesigned or codon-optimised the sensor proteins; only the regulatory context and the chromophore supply are theirs.
questions.trap_zh: 說自己重新設計或密碼子最佳化了 sensor 蛋白；其實只有調控環境和發色團供應是他們做的。
questions.basis: a judge will test whether they know what a port actually involves

questions.q_en: Bacillus subtilis runs plenty of its own two-component systems. What stops one of its histidine kinases from phosphorylating CcaR, and how would you find out?
questions.q_zh: Bacillus subtilis 自己就有不少 two-component 系統。有什麼東西能阻止它的 histidine kinase 去磷酸化 CcaR？你們要怎麼查？
questions.a_en: Nothing in our design does, and we never tested it. Two-component pairs are mostly kept apart by the docking surface between the kinase and the receiver domain, so a host kinase is usually a poor donor to a foreign regulator, and CcaR's target is a cyanobacterial operator no Bacillus regulator is expected to bind. The worry runs the other way too: small phosphodonors in the cytoplasm can charge a receiver domain and lift the dark baseline, which looks exactly like a leaky promoter. Our own results page already says the blots need a WB800 lane carrying no plasmid. A CcaR-only strain with no CcaS would separate the two.
questions.a_zh: 我們的設計裡沒有任何東西在防這件事，而且我們也沒測過。two-component 的配對主要靠 kinase 和接收區之間的介面維持專一性，所以宿主的 kinase 通常不是外來 regulator 的好磷酸供體；而 CcaR 認的是藍綠菌的操作子，應該沒有 Bacillus 的 regulator 會去結合。反方向的疑慮也在：細胞質裡的小分子磷酸供體可以把接收區充電，把暗態基線抬高，看起來就跟啟動子漏表現一樣。我們自己的 Results 頁已經寫了，墨點需要一條不帶質體的 WB800。再做一株只有 CcaR、沒有 CcaS 的菌，就能分開這兩件事。
questions.trap_en: Asserting the system is orthogonal because the parts are foreign, instead of naming the control that would show it.
questions.trap_zh: 因為零件是外來的就斷言系統正交，而不是講出能證明的對照。
questions.basis: orthogonality is assumed everywhere and tested nowhere

questions.q_en: Your sensor only works with the chromophore attached. How would you show that the CcaS-m3 in your cells is holoprotein and not apoprotein?
questions.q_zh: 你們的 sensor 只有接上發色團才會動。你要怎麼證明細胞裡的 CcaS-m3 是 holoprotein，而不是 apoprotein？
questions.a_en: We cannot show it yet, because there is no phycocyanobilin measurement anywhere in our records. The direct test is spectroscopic: extract the pigment and read its absorbance spectrum, or purify CcaS-m3 and look for the bilin absorbance band that an apoprotein does not have. The cheaper test is comparative: run the same output cassette with the ho1-pcyA module and without it, and feed purified PCB from outside in a third arm. If the response needs the module, the chromophore is doing the work. What we can say today is only cloning: the rebuilt chromophore module gave the expected 1,833 base pairs in eleven of twelve colonies, and clone 1 was sequence-verified.
questions.a_zh: 現在還不能證明，因為我們的紀錄裡完全沒有 phycocyanobilin 的量測。直接的做法是光譜：把色素萃取出來讀吸收光譜，或是把 CcaS-m3 純化出來看有沒有 apoprotein 不會有的 bilin 吸收峰。比較省錢的做法是對照：同一個輸出卡匣，一組帶 ho1-pcyA 模組、一組不帶，第三組從外面餵純化的 PCB。如果反應需要這個模組，就是發色團在做事。今天我們能講的只有選殖：重建後的發色團模組在十二個菌落中有十一個出現預期的 1,833 bp，clone 1 定序確認過。
questions.trap_en: Treating a sequence-verified ho1-pcyA module as proof that PCB is made and loaded onto the sensor.
questions.trap_zh: 把 ho1-pcyA 模組定序確認當成 PCB 已經做出來並裝到 sensor 上的證據。
questions.basis: the chromophore is the one component with no readout at all

questions.q_en: If phycocyanobilin runs short in the cell, what happens to your switch? And why might it run short?
questions.q_zh: 如果細胞裡的 phycocyanobilin 不夠，你們的開關會怎樣？又為什麼可能不夠？
questions.a_en: If PCB is short, part of the CcaS-m3 pool is apoprotein and cannot sense light at all. The sensing population shrinks, so the same green intensity gives less output and the dose-response looks shifted and less sensitive than the published curve. In the limit the promoter only reports its own basal activity, so the switch looks dead rather than leaky, which is a different diagnosis. It can run short because PCB comes from the cell's own heme: Ho1 and PcyA compete with the cytochromes and the catalases for that pool, and the cell needs heme to respire. Pulling hard on it is itself a burden. We have measured neither PCB nor heme.
questions.a_zh: 如果 PCB 不夠，一部分 CcaS-m3 就是 apoprotein，根本感不到光。能感光的比例變小，所以同樣的綠光強度輸出會變少，劑量反應看起來往右移、比文獻曲線不敏感。極端情況下啟動子只反映自己的基礎活性，開關看起來是壞掉而不是漏，這是完全不同的診斷。會不夠的原因是 PCB 來自細胞自己的 heme：Ho1 和 PcyA 要跟 cytochrome、catalase 搶同一個池子，而細胞呼吸也需要 heme，拉太兇本身就是負擔。PCB 和 heme 我們都沒量過。
questions.trap_en: Saying the switch would get leaky. Chromophore limitation kills the ON state; it does not raise the OFF state.
questions.trap_zh: 說開關會變漏。發色團不足是壓掉 ON，不是把 OFF 拉高。
questions.basis: distinguishes a sensitivity failure from a leak failure

questions.q_en: You put CcaR on Pveg and CcaS-m3 on PliaG or PlepA, which are not the same strength. Why that way round, and what breaks if the ratio is wrong?
questions.q_zh: 你們把 CcaR 放在 Pveg、CcaS-m3 放在 PliaG 或 PlepA，這幾個強度不一樣。為什麼這樣配？比例錯了會壞在哪裡？
questions.a_en: The regulator has to be the one in excess, so CcaR sits behind Pveg, the promoter we use for everything we want constantly on, and the receptor sits behind a weaker one; our parts page calls PliaG the weak constitutive promoter the light-sensing unit is deposited behind. With too little CcaR the kinase saturates the regulator pool and you lose the top of the range, because more light cannot make more phospho-CcaR. With too much kinase for the regulator the floor rises, because dark-state phosphorylation scales with how much kinase is there. We could not predict the ratio, so both receptor versions were built, and without a graded induction curve we cannot choose between them.
questions.a_zh: 需要過量的是 regulator，所以 CcaR 放在 Pveg 後面，那是我們用來讓東西一直開著的啟動子；受體則放在比較弱的後面，我們 Parts 頁就把 PliaG 寫成光感測單元登錄時所用的弱型持續啟動子。CcaR 太少的話，kinase 會把 regulator 池子打飽，範圍的上端就不見了，因為再加光也生不出更多磷酸化的 CcaR。kinase 相對太多的話，下限會被抬起來，因為暗態磷酸化跟 kinase 的量成正比。我們沒辦法事先算出比例，所以兩個受體版本都做了；沒有分級的誘導曲線之前沒辦法選。
questions.trap_en: Saying stronger is always better, or treating the two promoters as a redundancy measure rather than an untested variable.
questions.trap_zh: 說越強越好，或把兩個啟動子當成備援，而不是一個還沒測的變數。
questions.basis: stoichiometry is the classic two-component failure mode

questions.q_en: Your device puts four transcription units on one plasmid, and you deliberately diversified the RBS and terminator in module one. What does a construct that size cost the host, and what in your own data speaks to it?
questions.q_zh: 你們的裝置把四個轉錄單元放在同一個質體上，還刻意把模組一的 RBS 和終止子換掉。這麼大的構築對宿主的代價是什麼？你們自己的數據裡有什麼能講這件事？
questions.a_en: Four units on one replicon means four promoters competing for the same polymerase and ribosome pool, plus replicating 10,293 base pairs at whatever copy number it sits at, and the resistance marker on top. Our design argument is that gating the cargo on light lowers that burden while the plants are not stressed, but that is a design claim with no measurement behind it. The only growth data is the 19 September light plate: six arms at 0.279 to 0.317 per hour, all within one standard error. That is not a burden measurement, because every arm carried the same plasmid, and our hardware page says light leaked between wells, so those arms are not comparable anyway.
questions.a_zh: 四個單元在同一個複製子上，就是四個啟動子搶同一池 polymerase 和 ribosome，再加上要複製 10,293 個鹼基對（不管它的 copy number 是多少），還有抗性標記。我們的設計論點是把 cargo 用光控住，在植物沒受壓的時候可以降低這個負擔，但那是設計上的說法，背後沒有量測。唯一的生長數據是 9 月 19 日的光盤：六組在 0.279 到 0.317 每小時，全部落在一個標準誤內。那不是負擔的量測，因為六組帶的是同一個質體，而且我們 Hardware 頁說孔之間有漏光，所以那幾組本來就不能互相比較。
questions.trap_en: Quoting the six light arms as proof the plasmid is not a burden; those arms share one plasmid and leaked light into each other.
questions.trap_zh: 拿那六組當作質體沒有負擔的證據；那六組帶同一個質體，而且孔間還漏光。
questions.basis: they have growth data that does not answer the burden question

questions.q_en: Your light plate shines up through a two millilitre tube. The reactor is a stirred loop whose culture reaches OD600 of 3.8. What does green light actually do in there?
questions.q_zh: 你們的光盤是從下面打進 2 mL 的試管。反應器是攪拌的迴路，培養液 OD600 會到 3.8。綠光在裡面到底會發生什麼事？
questions.a_en: It does not reach the cells the same way. Light is a surface flux, so dose per cell falls as the culture thickens, and at OD close to four most of the green is absorbed and scattered in a thin layer near the wall while the cells in the middle sit in the dark condition. Our digital twin page lists exactly this among what is missing: induction light in the culture is not measured, and a dense culture will dim it by an amount nothing on the bioreactor reads. It also says green light is not built into the bioreactor at all, only onto the light plate. Scaling means a thin illuminated path or an illuminated side loop.
questions.a_zh: 它不會以同樣的方式到達細胞。光是表面通量，培養液越濃，每個細胞拿到的劑量越少；OD 接近四的時候，大部分綠光在靠壁的薄層就被吸收散射掉，中間的細胞其實在暗態。我們 Digital Twin 頁的缺口清單就寫了這一條：培養液裡的誘導光沒有被量測，而高密度培養的變暗程度是反應器上沒有任何東西在讀的。那一頁也寫了綠光根本沒有裝在反應器上，只裝在光盤上。要放大就得用薄的光程，或者做一條被照光的旁路。
questions.trap_en: Treating the light plate result as transferable to the reactor, or forgetting the reactor has no induction light at all.
questions.trap_zh: 把光盤的結果直接當成可以搬到反應器，或忘了反應器根本沒有誘導光源。
questions.basis: the light plate and the reactor are different optical problems

questions.q_en: CcaS and CcaR have been used by other teams and are published as a Bacillus toolkit. What did ReLEAF add beyond re-using them?
questions.q_zh: CcaS 和 CcaR 其他團隊用過，也已經有發表成 Bacillus 的工具組。ReLEAF 除了沿用之外，加了什麼？
questions.a_en: The switch itself is not our contribution and I would not claim it. Castillo-Hair's group characterised CcaSR in Bacillus, and our thirty-one registered entries are assembled from eleven Registry entries deposited by earlier teams and by the SubtiToolKit, CcaR, ccaS-m3 and the ho1-pcyA operon among them. What is new is the output side: the secretion fusions with their His tags, the codon-optimised AcdS 2.1, fourteen constitutive cassettes that give the light-gated version a benchmark, two complete Level 2 devices, and a microscale ACC deaminase activity assay. The light plate is also a published design; we added the dual-wavelength column layout and LEDs matched by measured output. Characterisation is what we did not add.
questions.a_zh: 開關本身不是我們的貢獻，我也不會那樣講。Castillo-Hair 的團隊已經在 Bacillus 裡 characterise 過 CcaSR，而我們登錄的三十一個條目是用十一個先前團隊與 SubtiToolKit 登錄的零件組起來的，CcaR、ccaS-m3 和 ho1-pcyA operon 都在裡面。新的是輸出端：帶 His tag 的分泌融合、密碼子最佳化的 AcdS 2.1、十四個持續表現卡匣作為光控版的對照基準、兩個完整的 Level 2 裝置，還有一套微量的 ACC deaminase 活性檢測。光盤也是已發表的設計，我們加的是雙波長的欄位排列和依實測輸出配對的 LED。我們沒有加上的就是 characterisation。
questions.trap_en: Claiming the light switch as an original contribution, or giving part counts without naming what is reused.
questions.trap_zh: 把光開關說成原創貢獻，或只報零件數量而不講哪些是沿用的。
questions.basis: positioning against prior art the judges already know

questions.q_en: Your whole project is light-controlled production. Tell me precisely what your green-versus-red data establish, and what they do not.
questions.q_zh: 你們整個專案是光控生產。請精確告訴我，綠光對紅光的數據證明了什麼、又沒有證明什麼？
questions.a_en: We have a light response, and it is not a graded one. Bands rise with time under green at every intensity, but they do not order themselves by intensity: green at 2 per cent was faint until six hours, while green at 12 per cent at eight hours was the strongest green lane, and red at full power was not silent at eight hours either. The ELISA on the 13 and 16 hour pair puts green above red by 1.1 and 0.4 micrograms per millilitre, two samples a side with overlapping ranges. The 19 September plate also leaked light between wells, so those arms are not comparable as doses. Light-dependent regulation is unverified.
questions.a_zh: 我們有光反應，但不是分級的反應。綠光下每個強度的條帶都隨時間增強，可是沒有按強度排序：綠光 2% 到六小時前都很淡，綠光 12% 在八小時反而是綠光各道裡最強的，而全功率紅光在八小時也不是沉默的。13 和 16 小時那一對用 ELISA 讀出綠光比紅光高 1.1 和 0.4 µg/mL，但每邊只有兩個樣本，範圍還重疊。9 月 19 日那塊盤子孔之間還有漏光，所以那幾組不能當成劑量來比較。光依賴的調控還沒有被驗證。
questions.trap_en: Overclaiming from the ELISA pair. It compares full green against full red, so it says nothing about the graded series.
questions.trap_zh: 拿 ELISA 那一對講太多。它比的是全功率綠對全功率紅，對分級系列什麼都沒講。
questions.basis: the central claim of the project, and the data are nearly there

questions.q_en: Your constitutive blot puts ACC deaminase at about 37 kilodaltons, but the light-plate bands run between 63 and 100. Why, and how would you settle it?
questions.q_zh: 你們持續表現的墨點把 ACC deaminase 放在約 37 kDa，但光盤的條帶跑在 63 到 100 之間。為什麼？要怎麼確定？
questions.a_en: The constitutive blot sits where it should: one band at about 37 kilodaltons in the supernatant, which is the size the secreted construct predicts. The light-plate blots are the problem. Against a monomer of about 35 kilodaltons, the ABDI bands ran near the 63 to 75 kilodalton markers and the ABDQ band between 75 and 100. Our own suggestion is a homodimer around 70 kilodaltons, and we label that a possibility, not a finding; our measurement page says the same, that identity is not settled by size alone. Settling it means re-running with fresh reducing agent and full denaturation, a positive control lane, and the expected mass computed from the fusion sequence.
questions.a_zh: 持續表現那張墨點落在該落的位置：上清液中一條約 37 kDa，正是分泌型構築預期的大小。問題在光盤的墨點。單體大約 35 kDa，但 ABDI 的條帶跑在 63 到 75 kDa 標記附近，ABDQ 的條帶在 75 到 100 之間。我們自己提出的解釋是約 70 kDa 的同源二聚體，而我們標明那是一種可能、不是結論；Measurement 頁也寫了一樣的話，光靠大小不能確定身分。要確定就得換新的還原劑、確實變性再跑一次，帶一條陽性對照，並且用融合序列算出的預期質量去對。
questions.trap_en: Stating the dimer as the explanation. The wiki calls it a possibility and promises validation, and the student should too.
questions.trap_zh: 把二聚體講成就是答案。wiki 說那是一種可能、要再驗證，學生也該這樣講。
questions.basis: a band twice the expected size needs an answer, not a guess

questions.q_en: You built reporter cassettes so you could read the switch out quickly. What happened to them, and what did that cost you?
questions.q_zh: 你們做了報導基因卡匣，本來是為了快速讀出開關的狀態。後來怎麼了？這讓你們付出什麼代價？
kw_zh: 半乳糖苷酶沒選殖成功
questions.a_en: Both failed, and both failed at cloning. AmilCP was chosen because a blue-purple colony can be judged by eye and then quantified on a plate reader. Gels gave fragments close to the expected size, but sequencing showed they did not carry the construct, and after repeated attempts with different chromoproteins we stopped. That taught us a band of the right length cannot tell a correct clone from an incorrect one. The galactosidase arm was a seven-part reaction with two redesigns, a 24-colony screen and a repeat, and no sequence-verified clone either. We also think AmilCP folds too fast inside the cell to secrete well through Sec. The cost is that every readout became a blot.
questions.a_zh: 兩個都失敗，而且都是在選殖這一步失敗。選 AmilCP 是因為藍紫色的菌落可以用眼睛判斷，再用吸光度定量。膠上出現接近預期大小的片段，但定序顯示它們並沒有帶我們要的構築，換過不同的色素蛋白反覆嘗試之後我們就停了。這教了我們一件事：長度對的條帶沒辦法分辨選殖株對不對。半乳糖苷酶那一組是七個零件的反應、改了兩次設計，篩了 24 個菌落還重做一次，也沒有定序確認的選殖株。我們也認為 AmilCP 在細胞內摺疊太快，不容易經 Sec 分泌出去。代價就是每個讀出都變成墨點。
questions.trap_en: Describing the kit's sfGFP dropout as their circuit reporter; that is a cloning screen, not a readout of PcpcG2.
questions.trap_zh: 把 kit 的 sfGFP dropout 說成他們的電路報導基因；那是選殖篩選，不是 PcpcG2 的讀出。
questions.basis: the fast readout failed, and that shaped every later experiment

questions.q_en: Name the experiment that would turn your light response into a control signal, in enough detail that I could run it tomorrow.
questions.q_zh: 請講出一個能把你們的光反應變成控制訊號的實驗，細節要夠到我明天就能做。
questions.a_en: Three fixes, then the intensity run. First the hardware: the 19 September plate leaked light between wells through the white tube holder, so the arms cannot be read as doses, and the rebuilt black holder has not been re-tested. Second the units: every reading we have is in lux, which is weighted for human vision, so until it is converted to photon flux our tiers cannot be placed on the published dose scale where the half-maximal intensity is 4.66. Third the blot: quantify it against a loading control and add a WB800 lane with no plasmid. Then repeat the dose series. Our results page calls this the most important next step.
questions.a_zh: 三個修正，然後才是強度實驗。第一是硬體：9 月 19 日那塊盤子透過白色試管架在孔之間漏光，所以那幾組不能當劑量讀，而重做的黑色架子還沒再測過。第二是單位：我們所有讀值都是 lux，那是依人眼加權的，在換成光子通量之前，我們的強度階沒辦法放到文獻那個半飽和光強 4.66 的劑量尺度上。第三是墨點：用載量對照把它定量，再加一條不帶質體的 WB800。然後把劑量系列重做一次。我們 Results 頁就把這件事列為最重要的下一步。
questions.trap_en: Jumping to more replicates. The leak and the lux-to-photon-flux conversion have to be fixed before a replicate means anything.
questions.trap_zh: 直接說要多做重複。漏光和 lux 換算到光子通量沒解決之前，重複沒有意義。
questions.basis: judges reward a specific closing experiment over an apology

questions.q_en: Your blots and your ELISA both read a whole culture at once. What could that miss entirely?
questions.q_zh: 你們的墨點和 ELISA 都是一次讀整個培養液。這樣可能完全漏掉什麼？
questions.a_en: The shape of the population. If only part of the culture responds, a bulk reading at ten per cent of maximum looks identical to every cell sitting at ten per cent, and those have opposite fixes: one is plasmid stability or chromophore loading in a subpopulation, the other is sensitivity across the whole culture. Plasmid-borne circuits are the classic case, because copy number varies cell to cell and cells that lost the plasmid still scatter light and still count in OD600. Telling them apart needs single cells, a fluorescent reporter on a flow cytometer. We had no materials for fluorescent reporters, and both chromoprotein reporters failed to clone.
questions.a_zh: 族群的分布形狀。如果只有一部分細胞有反應，整體讀到最大值的百分之十，跟每個細胞都在百分之十，看起來完全一樣，但解法剛好相反：一個是某個子族群的質體穩定性或發色團裝載問題，另一個是整個培養液的敏感度問題。質體上的電路最典型，因為 copy number 細胞之間本來就不一樣，而掉了質體的細胞一樣會散射光、一樣算進 OD600。要分辨就得看單細胞，用螢光報導基因搭配流式細胞儀。我們沒有做螢光報導基因的材料，而兩個色素蛋白報導基因又都沒有選殖成功。
questions.trap_en: Answering only 'we would need more replicates'. Replicates of a mean are still means.
questions.trap_zh: 只回答「要多做重複」。重複多次的平均值還是平均值。
questions.basis: bulk readouts cannot see an all-or-none population
